notes: PrefLib file 00022-00000002.toi (dataset 00022, 'sl'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 39 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.
